utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Hana’s coordinating the carpool, and Jules can help line things up. If we end up with an extra seat, Ira can take it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — 7:30 works for me, and Sam’s helping too. Rey can line up the Monday and Wednesday stops if needed.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That sounds good to me — thanks. If we need to, Ira can still take the extra seat.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Tuesday at 7:30 at 14 Cedar Lane still works. Quinn has Opal and Dane covered, and Ira can take one extra seat.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Leo — I’ll let Opal know the pickup is set. The morning carpool is at the church parking lot, so we’re good there.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — then we’re all set for Tuesday at 7:30 at 14 Cedar Lane.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: 8:00 works best for me. Gus can sort the timing and stop list if anything needs adjusting.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, I’ll send the drop-off times tonight with the pickup time and place, and if it all lines up I can do carpool this week.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — send it over tonight and I’ll skim it when it comes in. 8:00 still works best for me.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Rey’s available for the carpool, and Mondays and Wednesdays work for them. A 7:30 pickup is fine too—I can help line up the stops and timing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, thanks — Tuesday at 7:30 is still the plan, and I’ll keep the pickup list updated. Sam can help too, and I’ll make sure Kira and Tess stay in the loop if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — just keep me posted if the timing shifts, and I’ll help line up the stops.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s keep it clear: 8:10 at 14 Cedar Lane on Mondays and Wednesdays. Sam can help, and I’m set for the pickups.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good — I’ll keep that in mind, and once the time is set Vik can update everyone. Thanks for lining up the Monday and Wednesday pickups.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great — that keeps it clear. I’ll stick with 8:10 at 14 Cedar Lane on Mondays and Wednesdays.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: The carpool’s still on, and I’ll swing by on time. Ira can help fill a seat, and Cleo’s got the pickup list ready.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Good, but I still want the stops and timing double-checked with Gus first. Once that’s set, Vik can let everyone know.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — I’ll loop Gus in and get the stops and timing double-checked. Then Vik can let everyone know.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, you’ve got a saved spot—just meet us at 8:10 at 14 Cedar Lane. Sam’s helping out, and if we end up with an extra seat, Ira can hop in.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — I’ll be at 14 Cedar Lane at 8:10.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Opal — I’ve got your spot saved, and Dane’s too, so we’re all set at 14 Cedar Lane at 8:10. See you there!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m a little behind on the carpool—let me check whether the time changed and I’ll get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Noah—please confirm the stops and timing with Gus, and let me know if anything changed. Leo’s ready at 7:20, and Mina’s meeting me for the carpool.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I’ll check the timing and stops with Gus and let you know if anything changed.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help line up the stops and timing, and I’m free on Mondays and Wednesdays too. Gus can probably help with the route details as well.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, that helps a lot — I’ll keep 8:10 at 14 Cedar Lane as the carpool plan and save Dane a spot.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good — that works for me. I’m happy to help keep the stops and timing sorted.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Pickup’s set for 8:10 at 14 Cedar Lane, and I’ll keep everyone posted.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Vik — 8:10 at 14 Cedar Lane works, and I may be a little late again.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries — I’ll let everyone know 8:10 at 14 Cedar Lane is the plan.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, then Jules has Maya and Ben at 7:30, Sam’s helping too, and I’ll keep an eye out for that extra seat. Glad Hana and Leo are set for the carpool.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — once it’s all set, Vik can let everyone know. I’ll make sure Maya and Ben are covered and keep everyone updated.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — once Vik sends it out, we’ll all be on the same page. I’ll keep an ear out for that extra seat too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ll check in on the carpool and pass along Noah’s update once I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks — please let me know if there’s still room for one more. I’m happy to help if needed.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I will—I’m waiting on Noah’s update now, and I’ll let you know as soon as I hear whether there’s room for one more.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ll help keep everyone in the loop while we get the carpool set. Vik can let everyone know once it’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, but can you confirm Tess, Sam, and Bo are still in? I’m coordinating this, so I need the list settled.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can check on Tess, Sam, and Bo, and I’ll let you know once I’ve confirmed the list. Vik will still handle the update to everyone when it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: 7:30 should give us enough time, and I’m happy to help line up the stops and timing. Sam’s helping too, so we can make it feel unhurried.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds good — I’ll feel better once Gus and Hana have the stops and timing pinned down. Vik can let us know when it’s all set.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good — once Gus and Hana pin it down, we’ll be set. Vik can let us know, and I’ll help keep everything lined up.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’ll save Dane a spot, and the carpool is at 8:10 at 14 Cedar Lane.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: 8:10 works for me, and 14 Cedar Lane is fine. Gus can keep the timing and stops lined up if anything shifts.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’m happy to help, and I’ll keep Dane’s spot saved.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Noah’s checking the carpool and will report back to me, then I’ll pass it along to Mina.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good—I've got the pickup list, and the carpool is still Tuesday at 7:30. Sam can help if we need it, and Opal’s set for pickup.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that helps—I’ll wait for Noah’s update and then pass it on to Mina.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ve got the carpool set for 8:10 at 14 Cedar Lane, and I’m saving spots for Opal and Dane. Sam’s helping too, and Ira can take the extra seat if we need it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — let’s keep it at 7:30 for the carpool. Sam’s helping, and Rey can line up the Monday and Wednesday stops if needed.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Let’s keep it at 8:10 at 14 Cedar Lane — that’s the set time, and I’ve already got spots saved for Opal and Dane.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Rosa’s going to confirm the pickup spot and time, and then send them to me. I’ll keep an eye out for it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect — once I get the drop-off times tonight, I’ll send them to Mara and include the pickup time and place too. If the school times line up, I can do carpool this week.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, thank you — I’ve got 14 Cedar Lane at 8:10 on Quinn’s list, and I’ll wait for Rosa’s confirmation too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I might be a little late again, but thanks for saving me a spot. 8:10 at 14 Cedar Lane still works for me.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yep, I’ll double-check whether the carpool time changed and let Nell know too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — 8:10 at 14 Cedar Lane still works for me, and I may be a touch late again.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Hana’s coordinating it, and Jules can help line up the carpool. If Ira’s available, they can fill a seat too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it — the pickup is 8:10 at 14 Cedar Lane, and I’ll pass that along. If needed, Ira can fill a seat too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, that works. Dane might run a little late, so I just wanted to mention that too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Rey can do Mondays and Wednesdays, and 7:30 pickup works fine for them. I’ll help get the timing and stop list lined up.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, then we’ve got 7:30 covered for Maya and Ben with Jules, and Hana and Leo are still in the carpool too. I’m helping fill the last seat, so just send me the stop list when it’s ready.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Will do — I’ll line up the stop list and send it over as soon as it’s ready.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Tuesday at 7:30 at 14 Cedar Lane still works. Kira’s coordinating, and Quinn already has spots for Opal and Dane.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, 7:30 at 14 Cedar Lane still works for me too. I’ll keep Hana and Leo in mind, and Vik can update everyone once it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect — I’ll keep the 7:30 departure at 14 Cedar Lane, and Kira can keep coordinating. Let me know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: It’s still 8:10 at 14 Cedar Lane. Sam can help, Opal and Dane are set, and Vik can keep the plan simple for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, that sounds pretty solid. I’ll keep Gus posted if anyone drops out or the plan shifts.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good. If Rey needs the time, he’ll be there, and I’ll keep Mondays and Wednesdays in mind.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: The morning carpool is set for the church parking lot, and I’ll let Opal know the pickup spot and time. Around 8:00 a.m. should work well for Bo.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, 8:00 at the church parking lot works. Have you heard back from Nell about whether there’s room for one more?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I haven’t heard back from Nell yet, but I’ll check and let you know as soon as I do.
